summary: Frontend-only baseline evidence captured for pre-launch corrections; no application files were edited.

ui_bugs.issue: SQL preview block exceeds inspector width on desktop/tablet (e.g., margin-loss pre=569.5px vs inspector=410px at 1440x900)
Checkpoint icon is emphasized cyan tick in circle instead of neutral icon

integration_issues.issue: Desktop tab/focus order from Interpret is Ground -> Explain -> Compute; requested order is Ground -> Compute -> Explain

issues: Inspector tracks SQL intrinsic width, causing horizontal page overflow (doc_scroll_width > client_width).

action_items: Constrain SQL preview to inspector width (pre max-width/min-width behavior) while preserving scroll within pre.
Adjust desktop phase node DOM order to Interpret -> Ground -> Compute -> Explain.
Replace cyan validation tick treatment with neutral icon style.
Implement requested phrase/field emphasis sync updates in demo question phase as per brief.
critical_code_review_comments: AnalysisTrace desktop map renders PHASES[3] before PHASES[2], creating incorrect keyboard order.
ValidationCheckpoint hardcodes checkmark glyph (✓) and cyan accent class, preventing neutral presentation.
React console warns about unrecognized DOM prop defaultMuted/defaultmuted; should be corrected upstream.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/test_reports/prelaunch/before_matrix_playwright.py to rerun exact viewport matrix after fixes and compare against /app/test_reports/prelaunch/before.json.
rca of the issue: Overflow is caused by fixed/intrinsic SQL pre width exceeding inspector width in desktop/tablet layouts; desktop phase order mismatch comes from deliberate render order in AnalysisTrace map node placement (Explain inserted before Compute).
